extension.description: View Slurm jobs, scheduling details, accounting history and logs through Remote-SSH.
view.welcome:
Connect to a Slurm login node with Remote-SSH and install this extension on that host.
[Select user scope](command:slurm.selectUser)
[Refresh jobs](command:slurm.refresh)
[Find job by ID](command:slurm.lookup)
[Show query output](command:slurm.output)
config.user: Slurm user to query. Empty uses the remote OS user. Use * for all users.
config.binDirectory: Absolute directory containing squeue, scontrol and sacct. Empty uses the extension host PATH.
config.refreshSeconds: Refresh interval for the visible task list. 0 disables queue refresh. The output panel follows logs independently every 2 seconds.
config.timeoutSeconds: Maximum time for each Slurm query.
config.historyDays: Lookback window for accounting history and job lookup.
config.logTailKB: Maximum bytes per log read in KiB. The first read tails the file; the panel retains a bounded amount of output.
config.language: Language for the task list, details, prompts and logs. Native command and settings labels follow the VS Code display language.
